rounds.prompt: What is the combined worldwide box office gross of every Pixar feature film, from Toy Story (1995) through Toy Story 5 (2026)?
rounds.source: Box Office Mojo worldwide grosses, all 31 Pixar features summed: $18.7 billion

rounds.prompt: How many bowling pins could you stand upright on one bowling lane, packed side by side as tightly as they fit?
rounds.source: USBC Equipment Specifications Manual: lane length and width, pin diameter
rounds.qualifier: The whole lane, from the foul line to the back of the pin deck.

rounds.prompt: How much fuel does one of the world's biggest cruise ships burn in a day at sea?
rounds.source: Marine Insight: ships over 300 meters burn 235 to 250 tonnes a day
